summary: Comprehensive testing of IdeaRadar Iteration 4 features: PDF Export (Pro+ only), User Analytics Dashboard, and Navbar Dashboard link. All backend tests pass (12/12). All frontend UI tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF export correctly returns 402 for free users with clear upgrade message
Analytics endpoint returns all required fields with correct data types
Export PDF button conditionally shown only when user is premium AND brief exists
Scan Topic input correctly disabled for free users with appropriate placeholder
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Iteration 4 features verified working: 1) PDF Export returns 402 for free users, accepts token via query param, 2) User Analytics returns all required fields (briefs_generated, copies_generated, ideas_saved, topics_scanned, payments_made, tier, is_premium, recent_briefs, free_briefs_used), 3) Analytics page shows 6 stat cards with correct data-testids, 4) Dashboard link in user menu navigates to /analytics, 5) Export PDF button hidden for free users without brief, 6) Scan Topic input disabled for free users with PRO badge, 7) Theme toggle works correctly (dark/light).

pdf_export_endpoint.details: GET /api/ideas/{idea_id}/export-pdf returns 401 without auth, 402 for free users with 'Pro feature' message, accepts token via query param. Requires premium user AND generated brief to return PDF.

user_analytics_endpoint.details: GET /api/user/analytics returns all required fields: briefs_generated (int), copies_generated (int), ideas_saved (int), topics_scanned (int), payments_made (int), tier (string: free/pro/business), is_premium (bool), recent_briefs (array), free_briefs_used (int).

analytics_page_ui.details: Analytics page at /analytics shows: heading 'Your Dashboard', 6 stat cards (Briefs Generated, Landing Copies, Ideas Saved, Topics Scanned, Payments Made, Free Briefs Used), tier badge (Free/Pro/Business), Upgrade link for free users.

navbar_dashboard_link.details: User dropdown menu contains Dashboard link (data-testid='nav-analytics') that navigates to /analytics.

idea_detail_export_pdf_button.details: Export PDF button (data-testid='export-pdf-btn') correctly hidden for free users. Only shown when user.is_premium AND brief exists.

scan_topic_disabled_for_free.details: Scan Topic input (data-testid='scan-topic-input') disabled for free users with placeholder 'Upgrade to Pro to scan any topic...'. Scan Topic button (data-testid='scan-topic-btn') also disabled. PRO badge displayed.

theme_toggle.details: Theme toggle (data-testid='theme-toggle-btn') switches between dark and light mode. Both themes render correctly on all pages.

mocked_apis_list: Stripe uses test key (sk_test_emergent) - creates real test checkout sessions
Password reset code returned in API response (demo mode - no email service)
